channel.title: News Talk 980 CKNW - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: Montreal-area escape room named best in the world
item.description: Laval escape room Magnifico boasts enthusiastic actors and carefully-crafted set design that bring its creepy circus environment to life.

item.title: 2026 Alberta budget taxes criticized as ‘another version of equalization’
item.description: Terrible. Another version of equalization. Those are a few of the terms being used to describe the 2026 Alberta budget tabled in the provincial legislature in Edmonton on Thursday.

item.title: Alberta senior homebound while condo elevator awaits final inspection
item.description: Vikki and David MacKinnon say the elevator in their McKenzie Town condo was shut down for repairs back in December.

item.title: Vernon man killed in collision after escaping hospital during mental health crisis
item.description: Cool says there were no beds available in the psychiatric ward and that her son spent six days in a hallway in the emergency department, with only a brief period in a secure area.

item.title: Kelowna business community pushes back against province’s proposed PST expansion
item.description: On Feb. 17 , the province unveiled plans to expand the seven per cent provincial sales tax (PST) to services many businesses rely on, including bookkeeping and accounting.

item.title: Parents of 4-year-old killed in Horseshoe Bay bus crash still waiting for answers
item.description: After months in the hospital and dozens of surgeries, Silvana has recovered enough to go home and may be able to leave GF Strong in March.

item.title: Call of the Wilde: New York Islanders rebound to beat Montreal Canadiens 4-3 in OT
item.description: The New York Islanders forced overtime with an extra attacker in the final two minutes, then won it in the extra session 4-3. Brian Wilde has more.

item.title: ‘Ghosted’: Canadians stranded in Puerto Vallarta say they are abandoned by WestJet
item.description: British Columbians who were stuck in Mexico after violence erupted in Puerto Vallarta say they feel abandoned by WestJet with no help to get home.

item.title: Netflix walks away from Warner Bros deal, clearing the path for Paramount
item.description: Warner’s board announced that Paramount’s latest offer to buy the entire company for $31 per share was superior to the agreement it had previously struck with Netflix.

item.title: Canadians stranded in Puerto Vallarta after violence disrupts flights home to Edmonton
item.description: After cartel-related violence shut down travel in Puerto Vallarta, Edmonton families say they’ve been stuck for days trying to get home.
